# AgeOfMoney

> The premier Age of Empires esports betting platform (AoE4, AoE2, AoE3, AoM).

AgeOfMoney (ageof.money) is an online betting site for professional Age of Empires matches and
tournaments. Users bet with virtual tokens (⚜ coins) on matches drawn from the official
competitive circuits (Liquipedia, the official AoE events calendar). Crypto deposits via
NOWPayments. The site is bilingual: English (default) and French.

## Main features

- **1v1 match betting**: odds computed in real time by a Glicko-2 engine enriched with head-to-head
  and tournament data
- **Exact score betting**: bet on a match's precise score (e.g. 2-1)
- **Provably-fair roulette**: crypto-verifiable roulette based on public seeds
- **Coinflip**: 1v1 player duel with a fair random outcome
- **Jackpot**: shared pool where every player's stake enters a weighted draw
- **Global chat**: real-time community chat (Socket.io)
- **Leaderboard**: ranking of the platform's top bettors

## Games covered

- Age of Empires IV (AoE4)
- Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition (AoE2)
- Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition (AoE3)
- Age of Mythology: Retold (AoM)

## Tournaments and matches

Matches are scraped from Liquipedia (AoE wikis) and the official ageofempires.com calendar. Only
Tier S and A tournaments are included. Odds are recalculated every 10 minutes.

## Authentication

Sign-in via Steam only (Steam OpenID). No passwords are stored.

## Virtual economy

- 1 USD = 1.69 ⚜ (deposit)
- 1.69 ⚜ = 0.99 USD (withdrawal)
- XP level system based on wagered volume (20 levels)

## Key pages

- / — Home, LIVE and upcoming matches
- /matches — Full match list with game/status filters
- /matches/{id} — Individual match page with live odds and bet history
- /tournaments — Active tournament calendar
- /tournaments/{id} — Individual tournament page with its matches
- /leaderboard — Top bettors
- /roulette — Provably-fair roulette
- /coinflip — Coinflip mini-game

## Contact and support

- Support: /support (contact form)
- Privacy policy: /privacy

## Data notes

Odds are probabilistic predictions based on historical tournament performance. They are not
financial advice. Betting is available in virtual tokens only, with no real-money cash value.
